title: Return of the Jade Chamber?
description: You learn from a Millelith named Kun that there are plans to rebuild the previously destroyed Jade Chamber and that some small preparations to that end are already taking place...

dialogs.text: Hi. Would you like to buy anything?
We'd like a copy of "Meadow of Gems."
"Meadow of Gems"? We don't have it in stock here. Do you need it in a hurry?
Well, they're rebuilding the Jade Chamber...
Are they really? Well, that would require proper preparation, yes. Let me think...
Perhaps you can look for Qingzhou instead. He is extremely well-read — perhaps he might know where a copy of "Meadow of Gems" might be found.
Got it.
If my memory serves, Qingzhou often lodges at the Wangshu Inn. You can try looking for him there.
A conundrum. Most vexing, indeed...
So, uh, do you know anything about the "Meadow of Gems"?
The "Meadow of Gems," you say? Yes, I do recall that book.
I once went hither and thither in search of material with which to write a poem about merchants and happened upon this book in the process.
I did not fully comprehend the book's contents, but some of its anecdotes proved most inspirational nonetheless.
Let me try to recall the name of that poem. Pray, give me a moment...
Do you remember where I can find that book?
Ah, so you wish to locate that book? I must confess that no such place comes to mind...
However, if you need it urgently, I could just write you out a copy of it myself.
Write it out?
Ah, it was hardly a lengthy text. Memorizing it was no tall order.
More to the point, the book collector wouldn't let me loan it out.

And since poetry is not something that one can rush, I decided I'd simply write out a copy for my continued perusal... The book's contents were not very long, either, so I have it more or less memorized now.
That's seriously impressive work...
Ah, it is but a trifling matter, my liege. Still, perhaps you could do me a favor in exchange for the hand-written text.
As embarrassing as this is... I have been so focused on gathering inspiration here that only now do I realize: I have completely forgotten to eat today. Suddenly, I feel rather ravenous.
Could you help me get a serving of Triple-Layered Consommé? In exchange, I shall write you a copy of "Meadow of Gems."
I believe that I should just about be done by the time you return.
From memory?

flow.stepDescription: Give a serving of Delicious Triple-Layered Consommé to Qingzhou

dialogs.text: The "Meadow of Gems," how does it start... Ah yes, "Commerce and trade, like springs and streams, begin with the mountains and end with the seas..."
"This grand plan charts the course that will lead us, slowly but surely, to Liyue's longevity and the people's prosperity."
Ah, you've returned. One moment, I am still penning the last few lines...
Hmm... There. That should do it.
Here's your Triple-Layered Consommé...
Ah! That can wait, though — first, please see if the book is to your satisfaction. I trust that you will find my penmanship to be quite satisfactory.
This is seriously impressive work...
Hahaha, you praise me excessively, my liege. This book is for you. Don't lose it, now.
Hmm? Do you need anything?
I'd like to order some small ornaments made of bamboo...
Small bamboo ornaments, you say? I could do it, but may I know where this order is coming from?
It's from this checklist of Baiwen's...
Oho... an order from Yuehai Pavilion, is it? Well then, I suppose I should complete it as quickly as I can, then.
There is one problem, though: the bamboo forest that I frequently gather materials from has suddenly become occupied by a great many boars, for reasons unknown to me.
Though it is not much of a problem, I often have to go around them to collect bamboo...
If you could chase those boars out, I can go and collect some bamboo now, and we can begin work right away.
Leave it to me.
I shall wait for you here, then. Once you have chased those boars out, come back and give me a shout.

"There are those who lose their jobs and have no reliable source of food, nor a roof over their heads, they toil in vain in their barren fields. All the while, the wealthy merchants' residences overflow with gold and jade. What justice and uprightness is this?"
Though this passage still speaks of the mercantile way, it reveals quite a fair amount more meaning upon closer reading...
Hmm, small bamboo ornaments...

So, have you chased those boars away?
All of 'em.
That will do. I shall head over to collect bamboo in a while. Once the ornaments are ready, I shall have them delivered directly to Yuehai Pavilion.
This order is quite large. There's quite the sum to be made here...

Hello, can I help you?
So, about those preparations you've been making...
This is... the "Meadow of Gems"? Where did you get this book? I've searched high and low throughout Liyue, and I couldn't find it even so...
Qingzhou hand-wrote a copy for me.
That poet? Hmm, it seems that his reputation is well-founded...
Thank you for your help in preparing these objects. Once Master Lu sends those ornaments over, I will also arrange for him to receive appropriate compensation.
So, you're rebuilding the Jade Chamber, huh...
Indeed, we do have plans to do so. But with the number of things we will need to prepare, there is still much work to be done. I doubt that we can finish rebuilding it quickly.
Not to mention our biggest material headache, which we have yet to find a solution to...
Never mind, I shall not speak of it. Thanks for your help once again — and please, accept these for your aid. Now, if you'll excuse me, I must return to my work.
